text.p: Tropical Cyclone Josie has intensified over the last 12 hours and has once again become a significant threat to shipping. Top winds have reached 70 mph. Josie will continue to intensify in the Mozambique Channel over the next 12-24 hours before beginning a weakening trend. Shipping will continue to be impacted by this system.

Tropical Cyclone Gillian has dissipated off the coast of Queensland, Australia. The remnants of Gillian will continue to move inland over the next 6 hours and it could still cause locally heavy rains and flash floods this period but damage is not expected to be heavy. Meanwhile, a slow moving front to the south will pick up the moisture brought in by Gillian. This combination could lead to locally heavy rains and flash floods in interior sections of both Queensland and New South Wales during this period. The cotton and sorghum crops may be affected.
THERE ARE NO FURTHER EMERGENCY STATEMENTS AT THIS TIME
